supportingSources.label: Silverball Rules Out of Sight strategy

strategy.overview: Out of Sight starts by protecting both sides. Send the ball up top until the left side lane lights the left kickback and the right side lane opens the right gate. Then shoot the lit drop bank and its individually lit target for elevated points while each target also builds Bonus.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Out of Sight, go up top until the left side lane lights the left kickback and the right side lane opens the right gate. Then shoot the lit drop bank, especially the individually lit target. Completing a bank in three-ball play, or all ten targets in five-ball play, lights Double Bonus.
strategy.summary: Light both side protections before attacking the drops. Follow the lit bank and the small target lamp rather than forcing an unlit target. Use the center red star rollover to move the individually lit target when it improves the next shot.

quickInfo.name: Lit drop target
quickInfo.summary: Scores 500 instead of 50 and adds one Bonus step, or two with 10x lit.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Lights after either bank in three-ball play or all ten targets in five-ball play; it also lights on the last ball.

steps.text: Send the ball through the top lanes until both the left kickback and right gate are active.
Identify the lit drop bank and the individually lit target within each bank.
Shoot the best-controlled lit target; use the center red star rollover when moving the lit target creates a safer shot.
Complete either bank in three-ball play, or all ten targets in five-ball play, to light Double Bonus.
Keep collecting lit targets while preserving the two side protections.

buildsToward.title: Two protected sides and Double Bonus

steps.text: Light the left kickback and open the right gate.
Pick off lit targets for elevated points and Bonus.
Finish the required bank or banks to light Double Bonus.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play because the Double Bonus requirement changes, then confirm Special conversion and last-ball Double Bonus behavior.
Test all top lanes, left kickback, right gate, both five-target banks, individual target lamps, 10x lamp, center red star rollover, Bonus unit, and drop-target rebounds.
